body:
CHANGELOG updated in ECOWAR: Living Map Phase 7 shipped -- real arena<->living-map live wiring (BACKLOG.md SECTION 377): founder, playing the actual live client/server: 'can we make sure we get these updates in the client and the server? hitting g doesnt bring up card casting interface - no all cap win con - im not seeing frontier village ... i dont see a hex grid.' Root cause: every Living Map system built in Phases 1-2 was real and tested but never connected to any running match. New packages/simulation/living_map_bridge.h/.c: one real, live HexGrid/TownRegistry/CreepRegistry per match, founded at arena_init/arena_init_teams (2 Frontier Villages per side, 2 neutral/contestable towns, 3 cows), ticked + win-condition-checked every arena_update/arena_update_teams tick (owner/team 0 = faction 1 Dominion, owner/team 1 = faction 2 Symbiosis). Real naming collision found and fixed: arena_game.c's own pre-existing creep_spawn (unrelated node-guardian mechanic) conflicted with packages/livingmap's -- renamed the latter to living_map_creep_spawn across creep.h/.c and every test call site, the correct permanent fix now that both systems share a binary. New PACKET_ARENA_SNAPSHOT_LIVING_MAP/ArenaSnapshotLivingMapMsg (protocol.h), sent every broadcast tick since town/creep state can't be deterministically recomputed client-side like fountains/shops. apps/arena's minimap gained real town (diamond, faction-colored) and creep/cow (yellow dot) markers -- local demo reads the bridge directly, networked path reads a client-local mirror of the new packet. Live-verified end to end: a real fast-forwarded server + two real bots completed a full match (connect/draft/pick/live/end) with the new wiring active, zero crashes. 5 new tests (tests/test_living_map_bridge.c), full suite green (3169 assertions), both build scripts clean. Not done, honestly: no hex-grid outline drawn (dots only), no card yet calls town_attempt_convert/town_apply_militia_boost so nothing can actually flip a town in a live match yet (win condition is live but currently unreachable), G-key card-UI panel redesign still not built (separate, bigger client task), no visual confirmation possible in this sandbox (no display). (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
